selection: Keep source-eligible accepted candidates first; then maximize unused partition groups, prioritize NDC-free descriptions and rotate source categories with seed-42 ties. No model outcomes are used. Target sizes are computational budgets, not power claims.
relationship: Accepted PRIMARY/CONTROL relationships, or source-supported identical meaningful names, shared meaningful submitted brand base, same-labeler distinctive prefix variants, or non-generic name ratio >=92. These establish source-name relationships, not demonstrated clinical confusion or verified marketing ownership.
scope: Conventional source-labelled OTC categories lead; topical/dental/sunscreen and other source-resolved categories remain explicit strata. Homeopathic records stay secondary.
evidence: All input-derived candidates, complete active-ingredient text, original paired RxNorm records and identical source payloads for both Gemma checkpoints and the new deterministic comparator. No candidate or label truncation; no gold/review/split fields.
unresolved: Never score unresolved identities, incomplete source composition or disagreements as unique formulations. Preserve them in the decision ledger and diagnostics.
leakage: Keep final_v5 immutable. Quarantine training partition groups sharing meaningful submitted brand bases/anchors or ratio>=92 source-name relations with selected validation products. Stage 6 must enforce the frozen training allowlist.
